items.description: Framework grammar (57 줄, ADR 0024). Layer ↔ Trigger 매핑 + 4 단계 흐름 + Silent Skip 금지.

Framework 코드: reference-resolver, search-provider, self-test, doctor, layer-impact-gate, interview-loop, affected-test-runner, tdd-cross-verify, contract-diff, aftershock-reanalysis, host-pilot. doctor/self-test 는 ADR 0026 scope auto-detection 으로 host 에서는 BOTH check 만, framework dev 에서는 BOTH + FRAMEWORK_ONLY 둘 다 실행 context-index generator is included for Native Context Broker derived cache builds.
Git hooks (post-commit, pre-push, pre-commit-*) + N2.5 lifecycle hooks (on-tool-execute-before, on-response-completed, on-client-disconnect) + helpers.
Unified result schema + decision schema + layer-impact schema + reference-map schema + context-delivery packet schema + context-index schema.
39 trigger 파일: code-change/cross-layer/structured-ask 등 trigger 정의 + detector + fixture.
Framework self-test fixtures that must be present on hosts for BOTH-scope checks, including ADR 0037 workflow route cases + context-delivery fixtures.
Skill manifest. lazy-init/sync/doctor/test 등 어떤 skill 이 어디 있는지 single source.
본 manifest 자체. host 도 갖고 있어야 lazy-sync 가 동작.

Operational framework ADR referenced by AGENTS: implementation maps require Markdown, JSONL graph facts, and generated index cache. Synced under framework/operational-adrs in hosts so host decisions/ remains host-owned.

Operational framework ADR referenced by AGENTS: host knowledge search stays root-bound and missing records converge into current host .lazy-harness. Synced under framework/operational-adrs in hosts so host decisions/ remains host-owned.

Operational framework ADR referenced by AGENTS: user corrections about host role/source-of-truth/ownership converge into SSOT records. Synced under framework/operational-adrs in hosts so host decisions/ remains host-owned.

Operational framework ADR referenced by AGENTS: TDD/regression records must include SDD/BDD/SSOT/DDD impact judgement or cross-layer record updates. Synced under framework/operational-adrs in hosts so host decisions/ remains host-owned.

Operational framework ADR referenced by AGENTS: substantial analysis/planning discoveries must converge to records, candidates, or planning artifacts instead of chat-only knowledge. Synced under framework/operational-adrs in hosts so host decisions/ remains host-owned.

Operational framework ADR referenced by AGENTS and lazy route: workflow compression is read-only advisory, not safety reduction. Synced under framework/operational-adrs in hosts so host decisions/ remains host-owned.
Operational framework ADR: Capability Registry separates capability kind from enforcement level. Synced under framework/operational-adrs in hosts so host decisions/ remains host-owned.
Progressive knowledge graph pipeline plan. Hosts need this operating spec for dogfooding and M45-guided behavior.
SDD contract for knowledge graph candidates, drafts, canonical records, query, confirm/reject, and promotion.
ADR 0030 SDD standard for Markdown Implementation map sections, JSONL implementation graph facts, and generated implementation-index cache.
Non-destructive migration guide and automation levels for upgrading host records to ADR 0030 implementation maps.
SDD detector standard for exported UI component props/window-control contracts such as ChatWindow and WindowControls.
SDD standard for TDD/regression layer completeness: require SDD/BDD/SSOT/DDD judgement or cross-layer updates.
SDD standard for ADR 0034 analysis discovery capture: trigger cues, completion contract, Discovery capture judgement, candidate/planning sinks, and lifecycle helper behavior.
SDD standard for project-specific rule placement: route new rules to AGENTS, SSOT/ADR/layer records, planning, or .jcode-local workflow with an explicit Rule placement judgement.
SDD contract for Project Profile architecture and feature-navigation retrieval metadata consumed by Context Delivery.
SDD standard for option gate discipline: needs-option-gate is a waiting state, not approval to run tools, repeat prompts, or self-select Recommended.
SDD standard requiring .lazy-harness records/planning/knowledge search before session history when looking for recorded plans, rules, or intended work.
SDD standard for resolving caller git worktree root through LAZY_HOST_ROOT so symlinked .lazy-harness scripts validate the intended host checkout.
SDD standard for the canonical per-host lazy CLI entrypoint and stale package-script lazy:test guard.
SDD standard for D07 package health one-shot generate remediation and typecheck retry when generated-artifact drift is suspected.
SDD contract for lazy skill create: generated .jcode skill wrappers, optional scripts, safety rules, and skills.jsonl metadata.
SDD contract for capability registry Phase 1: list/resolve/audit without new blocking behavior.
SDD contract for ADR 0037 lazy route workflow compression: output schema, finite axes, default action table, and safety invariants.
SDD contract for compact Rule digest sections used by relevant-record query and lifecycle context injection.
SDD contract for intent-based canonical record query, compact digest output, ranking, status filtering, and token budget.
SDD contract for message.received pre-response relevant-record context injection and sanitized surfaced digest journal.
SDD contract for Native Context Broker packet output: raw hits, normalized evidence, required-read Context Delivery Packet, rendering, privacy, and fail-open rules.
SDD contract for response.completed audit against surfaced digests and missed record-completion guidance.
SDD contract for updating existing canonical records before creating new records.
Superseded compatibility SDD for legacy action-boundary project-policy hooks after ADR 0041 Phase 5.
SDD contract for ADR 0041 Phase 6 guidance ladder and hard-stop promotion criteria.
SSOT for knowledge graph storage paths and mutability rules.
SSOT for implementation map storage paths: layer Markdown, knowledge graph JSONL, generated implementation index.
SSOT for project-specific rule placement priority and canonical storage locations. Synced as a host-editable framework seed/reference.
SSOT for Capability Registry kind/level separation and non-blocking Phase 1 behavior. Host-specific capabilities.json remains host-owned.
Progressive knowledge graph stores plus host-local custom skill metadata: candidates, graph drafts, canonical graph, skills.jsonl. Empty JSONL containers are valid.
Policy for generated artifacts, including non-canonical implementation-index.json cache. Does not sync host generated cache contents.
